name: North Node Development
description: Defines North Node expression across universal developmental stages without converting direction into destiny.

content.coreRule: Development changes how the emerging capacity is approached; it does not convert the North Node into destiny or guarantee integration.

functionalPattern: Feels drawn toward unfamiliar experiences without a clear practice structure
Alternates between curiosity and retreat
Projects mastery onto others
Returns automatically to the South Node under pressure
learningTaskComponents: Notice when pressure triggers automatic return to familiarity

functionalPattern: Performs the emerging capacity rigidly
Rejects familiar strengths
Moralizes growth
Overcorrects away from the South Node
Uses aspirational identity to avoid actual practice
requiredConditions: explicit shame, comparison, or overcorrection evidence

functionalPattern: Practices the emerging capacity repeatedly
Experiments with different forms
Uses feedback to refine development
Begins coordinating the new capacity with familiar strengths
Uses the emerging capacity with increasing competence
Expands range without rejecting familiarity
Chooses between both poles according to context
Treats development as practice rather than identity proof
learningTaskComponents: Stabilize the capacity without making it rigid
Use the emerging function under greater complexity

functionalPattern: Moves between familiar and emerging functions without moral ranking
Uses the North Node capacity as part of a wider repertoire
Allows development to continue without identity inflation
Coordinates both poles with timing, context, and feedback
requiredConditions: sustained contextual use of both poles
developmentalContribution: Expands response range without invalidating established competence
Supports context-sensitive movement across the axis

crossStageRules.rule: The same emerging domain may use different verbs at different stages.
North Node development may remain incomplete without being invalid.
Integrated expression still preserves the South Node.
Healthy development does not imply comfort or social approval.
No stage may introduce a semantic domain absent from approved North Node vocabulary.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Developmental-direction vocabulary only. Psychology and development qualify expression but do not convert the North Node into destiny, moral ranking, or guaranteed outcome.
